about.storyTitle: We believe innovation is the foundation of Africa's future.

elution.title: Leaders in Efficient Gold Recovery and Processing
elution.lead: Welcome to Jema Elution, where we specialize in efficient gold recovery and processing from activated carbon, delivering results in the shortest time while maximizing cost savings.
elution.capacityNote: Our advanced high-pressure, high-temperature machines operate 24 hours, with a capacity of up to 1000kg.
elution.whyTitle: Let us help you achieve your goals with the most efficient gold recovery technology available today.
elution.whyIntro: At Jema Elution, we regularly maintain our machines, ensuring that the elution plant continues to run optimally, minimizing downtime and maximizing performance.
elution.processIntro: At Jema Elution, we use a proven process to ensure the efficient recovery of gold from activated carbon:
elution.processItem1Text: By using advanced monitoring and control systems, we optimize every aspect of the recovery process, ensuring consistent and reliable gold extraction.
elution.processItem2Text: We are committed to sustainable practices. Our machines are designed to reduce environmental impact, utilizing minimal water and chemicals during the recovery process.
elution.callbackTitle: Jema Elution is here to help.
elution.callbackSubtitle: Speak directly with our team about your gold recovery needs.
elution.contactIntro: We are here to assist you with any questions, support needs, or service inquiries.
